    • fromUrl

      public LinkHandler fromUrl(String url, String baseUrl) throws ParsingException
      Builds a LinkHandler from an URL and a base URL. The URL is expected to be already polished from Google search redirects (otherwise how could baseUrl have been extracted?).
      So do not call Utils.followGoogleRedirectIfNeeded(String) on the URL if overriding this function, since that should be done in fromUrl(String).
      Parameters:
      url - the URL without Google search redirects to extract id from
      baseUrl - the base URL
      Returns:
      a LinkHandler complete with information
      Throws:
      ParsingException

    • acceptUrl

      public boolean acceptUrl(String url) throws ParsingException
      When a VIEW_ACTION is caught this function will test if the url delivered within the calling Intent was meant to be watched with this Service. Return false if this service shall not allow to be called through ACTIONs.
      Throws:
      ParsingException
